page.layout: One page of text, centred headings and indented address lines; no margins, running head or page number. Below the dedication: the signature line "Resp." at lower right.

main_text.head: CLARISSIMO VIRO.
main_text.p: D. ARNOLDO GEULINCX, Phil. & Med. Doct. illiusque in illustri Lugdunensium Academ. Profesfori celeberrimo Præceptori & Præsidi honorando, de me studiisque meis optimè menrito[?] indiesque merenti.
main_text.head: VT ET,
main_text.p: Illi gregis qui Medenblici, isti qui Schagæ, huic qui Wieringæ Jesu Christo colligitur, Pastoribus vigilantissimis, fidelissimis, amicis meis integerrimis.
main_text.head: NEC NON
main_text.p: S. Sanctæ Theologiæ Studiosis diligentissimis Amicitiæ vinculo mihi conjunctissimis.

p.i: Hasce Theses Physicas in grati animi signum

page.notes: Printed "Profesfori" with a doubled long-s form, transcribed as printed. "optimè menrito" is faint: "menrito" is uncertain. A stray mark follows "me" in "de me studiisque". Background show-through from the reverse side (faint lines, letters and a stamp near the lower centre) is not transcribed.
